reference.kernels: pure-PyTorch reference paths (no kernels hub, fla or causal-conv1d installed)

messages.content: Briefly, in two sentences: why does the sky look blue during the day but red at sunset?

prompt.rendered: [gMASK]<sop><|system|>Reasoning Effort: Max<|user|>Briefly, in two sentences: why does the sky look blue during the day but red at sunset?<|assistant|><think>
prompt.decode_text: Sunlight scatters off air molecules, and blue light scatters more

notes.dtype_policy: fp32: FP8 weights dequantised with transformers' Fp8Dequantize to FP32, BF16/F32 tensors upcast; every parameter and activation FP32 on CPU
notes.prefill: the whole prompt in one forward (KDA uses the reference's chunked path)
notes.decode: one token per forward with the reference cache, continuing from the prompt (KDA recurrent path); decode.<name> tensors are stacked over steps, decode.sN.<name> are per step. The state before step 0 is in the matching -prefill set.
notes.weights: weights.*: the layer's small KDA tensors as the checkpoint stores them (exact); the FP32 goldens use them upcast. The projections (q/k/v/o, f_a/f_b, g_a/g_b, b_proj) are read from the checkpoint
notes.conv_rounding: the reference's short conv is the unfused PyTorch fallback: natively (BF16 weights and inputs) F.conv1d rounds its output to BF16, then SiLU rounds again. A fused conv + SiLU that rounds once differs from it by about 1 BF16 ulp on a fifth of the outputs (native notes.diff_vs_fp32: LNN.conv_fused_vs_reference). The FP32 goldens run the same code in FP32

prefill.in_streams.desc: decoder layer input: the 4 mHC residual streams [tokens, hc, hidden]

prefill.attn_hc.pre.desc: attention-site mHC pre weights (sigmoid + eps) that collapse the streams

prefill.attn_hc.post.desc: attention-site mHC post weights (2*sigmoid) that expand the block output

prefill.attn_hc.comb.desc: attention-site mHC comb matrix after Sinkhorn; new_stream[i] = sum_j comb[j,i]*stream[j] + post[i]*block_out

prefill.attn_hc.collapsed.desc: attention-site collapsed input sum_i pre[i]*stream[i] (before input_layernorm)

prefill.kda.f_proj.desc: forget-gate projection f_b_proj(f_a_proj(x)), before dt_bias [tokens, heads, dim]

prefill.kda.b_logits.desc: b_proj(x), before the sigmoid that gives beta [tokens, heads]

prefill.kda.path.desc: reference KDA path: 0 = chunked (64-token chunks), 1 = recurrent single step

prefill.kda.q.desc: KDA query after short conv + SiLU, before the L2 norm [tokens, heads, dim]

prefill.kda.k.desc: KDA key after short conv + SiLU, before the L2 norm

prefill.kda.v.desc: KDA value after short conv + SiLU

prefill.kda.g.desc: KDA forget gate (log decay per channel): -5*sigmoid(exp(A_log)*(f_b(f_a(x)) + dt_bias))

prefill.kda.core_out.desc: KDA recurrence output before the gated RMSNorm [tokens, heads, dim]

prefill.kda.state.desc: KDA recurrent state after the phase, FP32 [heads, k_dim, v_dim] (S[k, v]; out = q^T S)

prefill.kda.gate.desc: output gate g_b_proj(g_a_proj(x)) for the gated RMSNorm, before sigmoid [tokens, heads, dim]

prefill.kda.norm_out.desc: gated RMSNorm output o_norm(core_out, gate): the o_proj input [tokens, heads, dim]

prefill.mid_streams.desc: streams after the attention site's mHC update (input of ffn_hc)

prefill.ffn_hc.comb.desc: FFN-site mHC comb matrix after Sinkhorn

prefill.ffn_norm.desc: post_attention_layernorm output (MLP/MoE input; the routed rows sent to the experts)

prefill.mlp_out.desc: MLP or MoE block output (routed + shared for MoE)

prefill.out_streams.desc: decoder layer output: the 4 mHC residual streams

prefill.kda.conv_state.desc: short-conv cache after the phase: last 4 pre-conv inputs [channels q|k|v, 4], oldest first; column 0 never reaches an output

prefill.kda.qkv_preconv.desc: KDA q|k|v projections before the short convolution, concatenated [tokens, 3*heads*dim]

weights.self_attn.q_conv1d.weight.desc: checkpoint tensor model.language_model.layers.0.self_attn.q_conv1d.weight as stored (bfloat16); the module's conv1d weight is cat(q, k, v conv weights) along dim 0

weights.self_attn.k_conv1d.weight.desc: checkpoint tensor model.language_model.layers.0.self_attn.k_conv1d.weight as stored (bfloat16); the module's conv1d weight is cat(q, k, v conv weights) along dim 0

weights.self_attn.v_conv1d.weight.desc: checkpoint tensor model.language_model.layers.0.self_attn.v_conv1d.weight as stored (bfloat16); the module's conv1d weight is cat(q, k, v conv weights) along dim 0
